title: Derived pullback from a supplied K-flat model on an open
statement: Let f:T→X be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], U an open of X, and g:T→U.toScheme a morphism with g followed by U.ι equal to f. Choose ambient derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] for X and T and a derived category for the localized module site of U, with common morphism universe w. Let E be an object of D(O_X), and K a complex of modules on the localized site of U. Suppose restriction of E to that site is isomorphic to Q(K), and that the complex obtained from K by the canonical Modules.overEquiv U functor is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex] on U.toScheme. Then Lf*E [def-pc-derived-pullback] is isomorphic to Q of the complex obtained by applying Modules.overEquiv U followed by ordinary Modules.pullback g termwise to K. No boundedness, affineness, or quasi-coherence condition is imposed.

source.document: Stacks Project, Derived Categories of Schemes and Cohomology of Sheaves
source.place: Tag 08DW, proof (compatibility with restriction to open subschemes), and Tag 06YJ, final sentence (computation on K-flat complexes); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08DW and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/06YJ

proof.text: Set W to the whole open of T, b=W.ι, and r=f.resLE U W. The factorization through U implies W≤f inverse-image U, and cancellation of the monomorphism U.ι gives b followed by g equal to r. Choose standard derived categories on the two open subschemes, independently of ambient universe w. Exact restriction followed by the whole-open over equivalence is an equivalence, as seen explicitly by restricting along b and its inverse. Its induced derived functor therefore reflects isomorphisms.

Use lem-pc-derived-pullback-open-restriction-universes and the localization factorization of the canonical over equivalence to transport the supplied model to Q(P), where P is K transported to U.toScheme. The K-flat counit from def-pc-derived-pullback computes Lr*Q(P) as Q of termwise tensor pullback. The adjunction of lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction and the ordinary module-pullback adjunction identify this with Q of ordinary pullback r applied termwise to P.

The overFunctorEquiv for W, its identification with ordinary pullback b, the ordinary pullback-composition isomorphism, and b followed by g equal to r identify restriction of the proposed right-hand complex with the same complex on W. Lift this natural isomorphism termwise and through Q. Compose with the previous comparison and reflect the resulting isomorphism through the fully faithful derived whole-open restriction.

proof_origin.note: Explicitly expands the canonical local-model restriction argument and handles independent localization universes.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedPullback_local_kFlat_model {T X : Scheme.{u}} (f : T ⟶ X)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))]
    (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (g : T ⟶ U.toScheme) (hcomp : g ≫ U.ι = f)
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hK : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := U.toScheme.sheaf)
      (((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K))
    (hmodel : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) :
    Nonempty ((derivedPullback f).obj E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
        ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback g) (.up ℤ)).obj K))
